Dear Timothy,

Join us this tomorrow, July 1st at 11:00am ET when our CEO Keith McCullough presents our flagship Q3 2025 Macro Themes.

During this 60-minute webcast, McCullough will walk investors through a deep slide deck explaining the 3 major themes we believe will drive returns in the months ahead—and how to capitalize on them over multiple durations:

Trade (immediate-term), Trend (3+ months), and Tail (longer-term).

This webcast and 150+ slide deck is exclusive to Institutional, Pro Risk Manager, and Macro Pro subscribers. You can get access with our special Fourth of July Sale (66% off 3 months: https://info.hedgeye.com/e/764243/romo-3-monthsp-a-macro-pro-828/2sr29qf/2125598115/h/-_J1bd-FL483LuwDxLUqIixQxf80t-tNYr2DeuBUc_c).

Schedule a walkthrough to learn more about what's inside: https://info.hedgeye.com/e/764243/jamie-bruno-/2sr29qj/2125598115/h/-_J1bd-FL483LuwDxLUqIixQxf80t-tNYr2DeuBUc_c

Here’s what we’re covering in Q3:

Inflation’s Re-Acceleration (USA):

	We’ll map the full Quad progression from Jan → July and detail what comes next.
	Inflation showing risk to the upside.
	Structural market changes intensifying.
	Macro/Policy catalysts converging this summer.
	A roadmap to position confidently ahead of the big shifts.

Global #Quad2 Remains:

	Despite tariff noise, global growth has held firm.
	Trade didn’t retreat—it rerouted.
	India, Belgium, Australia, and others are now thriving.
	And with the U.S. dollar still down double digits from its peak, the global backdrop remains supportive.
	We’ll show you where the strength is—and what might crack first.

Policy Impact (Tariffs, Tax Cuts, Stablecoins):

	Q3 is the in-between quarter—post-DOGE and pre-Tax Cuts.
	This is when the impacts of 1H policy frictions begin to show up in both growth and inflation.
	We’ll walk through the sequencing and effects—from tariff timelines to Stablecoin regulation to debt-driven fiscal risk.
